name: esap
description: Emil's Super App Planner. Copy this to dsh.workspace.json in the project and change what is untrue of yours.

run_test.description: Run one Rust test target that this task owns. Not the whole suite: name a target from the list.

target.description: the crate and test name, as in plain-core:comments

ui_spec.description: Run one Playwright UI spec by name. It takes the project's machine lock, so it waits if another measurement is running.

name.description: the spec file's name, without the extension

vitest.description: Run one vitest file that this task owns.

file.description: a path under src/, as written for vitest

every_command.description: Run the registry test that checks every core command is reachable from a menu and on NOT_BUILT while the app does not run it. Needs ui_spec to have passed first.
